build_object_deduplicator: build an ObjectDeduplicator instance that initializes a pretrained ResNet18 model for object deduplication
create_feature_representation: create a feature representation vector from an image using the pretrained ResNet18 model
test_is_match: test the is_match method to determine if two objects are the same based on cosine similarity and spatial distance
review_is_novel: review the is_novel method that compares a current object against previous objects using feature matching
run_deduplication: run the deduplication handler on current and previous objects to assign unique entity IDs
